name: practice-software-testing-playwright
description: Automação E2E com Playwright para fluxos de cadastro e login no Practice Software Testing.

scripts.allure:generate: set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1" && set "PATH=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1\bin;%PATH%" && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.allure:open: set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1" && set "PATH=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1\bin;%PATH%" && allure open allure-report
scripts.allure:serve: set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1" && set "PATH=C:\Program Files\Java\jdk-26.0.1\bin;%PATH%" && allure serve allure-results
